# RemovalsNation

> RemovalsNation is a UK removals company offering house removals, office removals,
> man and van hire, storage, packing services, same-day removals, international
> removals, and piano removals, with fully insured teams covering 1252+
> towns and cities across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Every
> job is fully insured (public liability and goods-in-transit) with no hidden
> fees; quotes are confirmed online in about 60 seconds or by phone on +44 7417 355780.

Last updated: 2026-09-14

## Services
- [House Removals](https://removalsnation.com/house-removals/index.html) — full house moves, priced by property size
- [Office Removals](https://removalsnation.com/office-removals/index.html) — business relocations, IT equipment moves
- [Man & Van](https://removalsnation.com/man-and-van/index.html) — hourly-rate hire for smaller loads, same-day available
- [Storage](https://removalsnation.com/storage/index.html) — short- or long-term unit storage, flexible billing
- [Packing Services](https://removalsnation.com/packing-services/index.html) — full or partial professional packing
- [Same Day Removals](https://removalsnation.com/same-day-removals/index.html) — urgent/short-notice removals
- [International Removals](https://removalsnation.com/international-removals/index.html) — moving abroad, sea and air freight
- [Piano Removals](https://removalsnation.com/piano-removals/index.html) — specialist upright and grand piano moving
